articles.title: Trad.Fi, W3 target $650 million in onchain private credit using AI evaluation
articles.snippet: Equipment-financing lender Trad.Fi is working with W3 to automate capital workflows and bring real-economy business lending onto public blockchain rails.

articles.title: BlackRock warns of energy shock as May CPI is set to show acceleration in inflation
articles.snippet: BlackRock is closely watching Wednesday's CPI as an early test of how U.S.-Iran tensions are feeding into already elevated prices in the economy.

articles.title: Strategy's bitcoin purchase fails to stir BTC price
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is little changed despite a new purchase by Strategy as risk-averse investors await U.S. inflation data and next week’s Fed meeting.

articles.title: Saylor blamed AI for bitcoin crash. Arca has one word for that: Nonsense
articles.snippet: Arca is blaming Strategy's sale of 32 BTC for last week's BTC crash, not AI capital rotation, as Strategy's Saylor claimed.

articles.title: Humanity Protocol token crashes more than 80% after a $32 million private-key hack
articles.snippet: The decentralized identity project said attackers compromised the keys of a foundation member and are dumping the stolen H tokens for ether.
